Class StatSet

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Stats
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Manages stats and their active modifier sources. This is the new entry point of the stat system. You create stats, add modifier sources, call Update(dt) each frame if you have timed effects, and read the final stat values back out.

  • Holds Stat objects and IStatModifierSource (like StatModifierSource, TimedStatModifierSource, StackableStatModifierSource)
  • Formula: ((Base + Flat) * (1 + AdditivePercent)) * MultiplicativeFactor

Remarks

Main flow:

  • You define a stat with new Stat(...).
  • You register it in StatSet.AddStat(...).
  • You register one or more sources with StatSet.AddSource(...).
  • StatSet recalculates all stats from all active sources.
  • If you have timed sources, you call StatSet.Update(dt) each frame.
  • You read the result with StatSet.GetValue(statId) or stat.Value.

What each class is for

  • StatId: a lightweight wrapper around uint, used as the stable key for stats.
  • Stat: one actual stat definition plus its current computed value, name, base value, optional min/max, and optional tags.
  • StatModifier: one contribution to one stat, like “+5 flat” or “+20% multiplicative”.
  • StatModifierKind: says how the modifier participates in the calculation pipeline.
  • StatModifierSource: a permanent or manually removed source, like an item affix or passive.
  • TimedStatModifierSource: a source with duration and expiry.
  • StackableStatModifierSource: a timed source whose modifiers scale by stack count.
  • StatSet: the manager that holds everything, updates timed sources, and recalculates values.

How stacking works:

  • Sources have a stable Id.
  • If you add a source with an id that already exists, StatSet does not add a second copy.
  • Instead, it calls Reapply(...) on the existing source.
  • For timed sources, Reapply(...) refreshes duration.
  • For stackable sources, Reapply(...) adds stacks and refreshes duration by default.
  • AddStacks(uint, int) and RemoveStacks(uint, int) let you manipulate an existing source directly.

Batch()

Creates a disposable scope for batching multiple stat changes. When the scope is disposed, all pending recalculations are performed at once. Supports nesting: each Batch() call must be paired with Dispose().

public IDisposable Batch()

Returns

IDisposable

An IDisposable that ends the batch when disposed.

BeginUpdate()

Begins a batch update. Multiple changes can be made without triggering recalculation until EndUpdate() is called.

public void BeginUpdate()

Remarks

Supports nesting: each BeginUpdate must be paired with an EndUpdate. Recalculation happens only when the outermost EndUpdate is called.

Clear()

Clears all stats and modifier sources from the set and recalculates values.

public void Clear()

Remarks

Raises OnStatRemoved for each removed stat and OnSourceRemoved for each removed source.
